headline: Liquor license for Supreme Food Marketplace, 590 Main Street; used car dealer license for Western Mass Cars, 143 Parker Street; farmer winery license, Forest Park.
summary: The agenda includes two new license petitions. It also includes a discussion of a farmer winery license for the Forest Park Winter Market.
items: New petition for annual liquor license, off-premises beer and wine package store, RZJ Corporation dba Supreme Food Marketplace, 590 Main Street; Rosanna D Acosta, manager of record
New petition for Class II (used car) car dealer license, Auto Management Group LLC dba Western Mass Cars, 143 Parker Street, Indian Orchard; Kevin Conway, manager of record

Discussion of farmer winery license to sell at the Farmers Market at Forest Park Winter Market, 200 Trafton St, at the Monkey House Building at Forest Park, November 7, 2026 through April 17, 2027, biweekly on Saturdays, 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM
location: Room 205, 2nd Floor, City Hall, 36 Court Street (also via Zoom)
